title: Concept: npm client sends credentials on every request
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that attaches registry credentials to every request, not only to authenticated calls, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The token is offered to mirrors, proxies and any host the client is pointed at, which widens the audience of one leaked configuration.
risk: The token is offered to mirrors, proxies and any host the client is pointed at, which widens the audience of one leaked configuration.
